verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ כִּֽי־ זָקֵ֣ן יִצְחָ֔ק וַתִּכְהֶ֥יןָ עֵינָ֖יו מֵרְאֹ֑ת וַיִּקְרָ֞א אֶת־ עֵשָׂ֣ו׀ בְּנ֣וֹ הַגָּדֹ֗ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ בְּנִ֔י וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו הִנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî- zā·qên yiṣ·ḥāq wat·tiḵ·he·nā ‘ê·nāw mê·rə·’ōṯ way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- ‘ê·śāw bə·nōw hag·gā·ḏōl way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw bə·nî way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw hin·nê·nî
verses.literal: When Isaac was old and his eyes were so weak that he could no longer see he called his older son Esau and said to him My son Here I am Esau replied . . .
verses.literalPt: Quando Isaque já estava velho, e os olhos se lhe enfraqueciam, de modo que não podia ver, chamou a Esaú, seu filho mais velho, e disse-lhe: Filho meu. Respondeu ele: Eis-me aqui.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּה־ נָ֖א זָקַ֑נְתִּי לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְתִּי י֥וֹם מוֹתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hin·nêh- nā zā·qan·tî lō yā·ḏa‘·tî yō·wm mō·w·ṯî
verses.literal: Look said Isaac I am now old and I do not know the day of my death
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe o pai: Eis que estou velho e não sei o dia da minha morte.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ שָׂא־ נָ֣א כֵלֶ֔יךָ תֶּלְיְךָ֖ וְקַשְׁתֶּ֑ךָ וְצֵא֙ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וְצ֥וּדָה לִּ֖י צֵידָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh śā- nā ḵê·le·ḵā tel·yə·ḵā wə·qaš·te·ḵā wə·ṣê haś·śā·ḏeh wə·ṣū·ḏāh lî ṣē·ḏå̄h
verses.literal: Take . . . your weapons your quiver and bow and go out into the field to hunt some game for me
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, toma as tuas armas, a tua aljava e o teu arco, sai ao campo e apanha para mim uma caça.

verses.original: וַעֲשֵׂה־ לִ֨י מַטְעַמִּ֜ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהַ֛בְתִּי וְהָבִ֥יאָה לִּ֖י וְאֹכֵ֑לָה בַּעֲב֛וּר תְּבָרֶכְךָ֥ נַפְשִׁ֖י בְּטֶ֥רֶם אָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śêh- lî maṭ·‘am·mîm ka·’ă·šer ’ā·haḇ·tî wə·hā·ḇî·’āh lî wə·’ō·ḵê·lāh ba·‘ă·ḇūr tə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā nap̄·šî bə·ṭe·rem ’ā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Then prepare a tasty dish that I love and bring it to me to eat so that I may bless you before I die
verses.literalPt: Faze-me um manjar saboroso, como eu gosto, e traze-mo, para que eu coma, a fim de que a minha alma te abençoe antes que eu morra.

verses.original: וְרִבְקָ֣ה שֹׁמַ֔עַת בְּדַבֵּ֣ר יִצְחָ֔ק אֶל־ עֵשָׂ֖ו בְּנ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ עֵשָׂו֙ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לָצ֥וּד צַ֖יִד לְהָבִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·riḇ·qāh šō·ma·‘aṯ bə·ḏab·bêr yiṣ·ḥāq ’el- ‘ê·śāw bə·nōw way·yê·leḵ ‘ê·śāw haś·śā·ḏeh lā·ṣūḏ ṣa·yiḏ lə·hā·ḇî
verses.literal: Now Rebekah was listening to what Isaac told . . . his son Esau So when Esau went into the field to hunt game and bring it back
verses.literalPt: Rebeca estava escutando quando Isaque falou a Esaú, seu filho. Esaú foi ao campo para apanhar caça e trazê-la.

verses.original: וְרִבְקָה֙ אָֽמְרָ֔ה אֶל־ יַעֲקֹ֥ב בְּנָ֖הּ לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֤ה שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ אֶת־ אָבִ֔יךָ מְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ עֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִ֖יךָ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·riḇ·qāh ’ā·mə·rāh ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·nāh lê·mōr hin·nêh šā·ma‘·tî ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā mə·ḏab·bêr ’el- ‘ê·śāw ’ā·ḥî·ḵā lê·mōr
verses.literal: Rebekah said to her son Jacob Behold I overheard your father saying to your brother . . . Esau
verses.literalPt: Disse Rebeca a Jacó, seu filho: Ouvi a teu pai falar com Esaú, teu irmão, dizendo:

verses.original: הָבִ֨יאָה לִּ֥י צַ֛יִד וַעֲשֵׂה־ לִ֥י מַטְעַמִּ֖ים וְאֹכֵ֑לָה וַאֲבָרֶכְכָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י מוֹתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇî·’āh lî ṣa·yiḏ wa·‘ă·śêh- lî maṭ·‘am·mîm wə·’ō·ḵê·lāh wa·’ă·ḇā·reḵ·ḵāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh lip̄·nê mō·w·ṯî
verses.literal: Bring me some game and prepare me a tasty dish to eat so that I may bless you in the presence of the LORD before I die
verses.literalPt: Traze-me caça e faze-me um manjar saboroso, para que eu coma e te abençoe diante de Jeová, antes que eu morra.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֥ה בְנִ֖י שְׁמַ֣ע בְּקֹלִ֑י לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י מְצַוָּ֥ה אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ḇə·nî šə·ma‘ bə·qō·lî la·’ă·šer ’ă·nî mə·ṣaw·wāh ’ō·ṯāḵ
verses.literal: Now my son listen to my voice and do exactly as I tell you
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, meu filho, escuta a minha voz naquilo em que eu te mando.

verses.original: לֶךְ־ נָא֙ אֶל־ הַצֹּ֔אן וְקַֽח־ לִ֣י מִשָּׁ֗ם שְׁנֵ֛י גְּדָיֵ֥י עִזִּ֖ים טֹבִ֑ים וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂ֨ה אֹתָ֧ם מַטְעַמִּ֛ים לְאָבִ֖יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: leḵ- nā ’el- haṣ·ṣōn wə·qaḥ- lî miš·šām šə·nê gə·ḏā·yê ‘iz·zîm ṭō·ḇîm wə·’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’ō·ṯām maṭ·‘am·mîm lə·’ā·ḇî·ḵā ka·’ă·šer ’ā·hêḇ
verses.literal: Go out . . . to the flock and bring me . . . two choice young goats . . . so that I can make them into a tasty dish for your father the kind he loves
verses.literalPt: Vai ao rebanho e traze-me de lá das cabras dois bons cabritos. Deles farei um manjar saboroso para teu pai, como ele gosta;

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ לְאָבִ֖יךָ וְאָכָ֑ל בַּעֲבֻ֛ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְבָרֶכְךָ֖ לִפְנֵ֥י מוֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā lə·’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·’ā·ḵāl ba·‘ă·ḇur ’ă·šer yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā lip̄·nê mō·w·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then take it to your father to eat so that he may bless you before he dies
verses.literalPt: levá-lo-ás a teu pai, para que o coma, a fim de te abençoar antes que ele morra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֶל־ רִבְקָ֖ה אִמּ֑וֹ הֵ֣ן עֵשָׂ֤ו אָחִי֙ אִ֣ישׁ שָׂעִ֔ר וְאָנֹכִ֖י אִ֥ישׁ חָלָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- riḇ·qāh ’im·mōw hên ‘ê·śāw ’ā·ḥî ’îš śā·‘ir wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’îš ḥā·lāq
verses.literal: Jacob . . . answered his mother Rebekah Look my brother Esau is a hairy man but I am . . . smooth-skinned
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Jacó a Rebeca, sua mãe: Eis que Esaú, meu irmão, é homem peloso, e eu sou liso.

verses.original: אוּלַ֤י יְמֻשֵּׁ֙נִי֙ אָבִ֔י וְהָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינָ֖יו כִּמְתַעְתֵּ֑עַ וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י עָלַ֛י קְלָלָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א בְרָכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lay yə·muš·šê·nî ’ā·ḇî wə·hā·yî·ṯî ḇə·‘ê·nāw kim·ṯa‘·tê·a‘ wə·hê·ḇê·ṯî ‘ā·lay qə·lā·lāh wə·lō ḇə·rā·ḵāh
verses.literal: What if my father touches me Then I would be revealed to him as a deceiver and I would bring upon myself a curse rather than a blessing
verses.literalPt: Porventura, meu pai me apalpará, e serei aos seus olhos como mofador; e trarei sobre mim uma maldição e não uma bênção.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ אִמּ֔וֹ עָלַ֥י קִלְלָתְךָ֖ בְּנִ֑י אַ֛ךְ שְׁמַ֥ע בְּקֹלִ֖י וְלֵ֥ךְ קַֽח־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lōw ’im·mōw ‘ā·lay qil·lā·ṯə·ḵā bə·nî ’aḵ šə·ma‘ bə·qō·lî wə·lêḵ qaḥ- lî
verses.literal: His mother replied Your curse be on me my son Just obey my voice and go get them for me
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe sua mãe: Sobre mim caia a tua maldição, filho meu; somente escuta a minha voz e vai traze-mos.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ וַיִּקַּ֔ח וַיָּבֵ֖א לְאִמּ֑וֹ וַתַּ֤עַשׂ אִמּוֹ֙ מַטְעַמִּ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָהֵ֥ב אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ way·yiq·qaḥ way·yā·ḇê lə·’im·mōw wat·ta·‘aś ’im·mōw maṭ·‘am·mîm ka·’ă·šer ’ā·hêḇ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: So Jacob went and got two goats and brought them to his mother who made the tasty food his father loved
verses.literalPt: Foi ele, tomou-os e os trouxe à sua mãe, que fez um manjar saboroso, como seu pai gostava.

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֣ח רִ֠בְקָה אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֨י עֵשָׂ֜ו בְּנָ֤הּ הַגָּדֹל֙ הַחֲמֻדֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתָּ֖הּ בַּבָּ֑יִת וַתַּלְבֵּ֥שׁ אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּנָ֥הּ הַקָּטָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·qaḥ riḇ·qāh ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê ‘ê·śāw bə·nāh hag·gā·ḏōl ha·ḥă·mu·ḏōṯ ’ă·šer ’it·tāh bab·bā·yiṯ wat·tal·bêš ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·nāh haq·qā·ṭān
verses.literal: And Rebekah took the finest clothes in the house that belonged to her older son Esau and she put them on her younger son Jacob
verses.literalPt: Ela tomou os melhores vestidos de Esaú, seu filho mais velho, que tinha consigo em casa, e vestiu a Jacó, seu filho mais moço;

verses.original: וְאֵ֗ת עֹרֹת֙ גְּדָיֵ֣י הָֽעִזִּ֔ים הִלְבִּ֖ישָׁה עַל־ יָדָ֑יו וְעַ֖ל חֶלְקַ֥ת צַוָּארָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ ‘ō·rōṯ gə·ḏā·yê hā·‘iz·zîm hil·bî·šāh ‘al- yā·ḏāw wə·‘al ḥel·qaṯ ṣaw·wā·rāw
verses.literal: She also put the skins of the young goats on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck
verses.literalPt: com as peles dos cabritos cobriu-lhe as mãos e a lisura do pescoço

verses.original: וַתִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת־ הַמַּטְעַמִּ֛ים וְאֶת־ הַלֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑תָה בְּיַ֖ד יַעֲקֹ֥ב בְּנָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tit·tên ’eṯ- ham·maṭ·‘am·mîm wə·’eṯ- hal·le·ḥem ’ă·šer ‘ā·śā·ṯāh bə·yaḏ ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·nāh
verses.literal: Then she handed . . . her son Jacob the tasty food and bread she had made
verses.literalPt: e pôs na mão de seu filho Jacó o manjar saboroso e o pão que havia preparado.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א אֶל־ אָבִ֖יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אָבִ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הִנֶּ֔נִּי מִ֥י אַתָּ֖ה בְּנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’el- ’ā·ḇîw way·yō·mer ’ā·ḇî way·yō·mer hin·nen·nî mî ’at·tāh bə·nî
verses.literal: So Jacob went to his father and said My father Here I am he answered Which one are you my son
verses.literalPt: Jacó foi a seu pai e disse: Meu pai! Ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui; quem és tu, meu filho?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶל־ אָבִ֗יו אָנֹכִי֙ עֵשָׂ֣ו בְּכֹרֶ֔ךָ עָשִׂ֕יתִי כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ אֵלָ֑י קֽוּם־ נָ֣א שְׁבָ֗ה וְאָכְלָה֙ מִצֵּידִ֔י בַּעֲב֖וּר תְּבָרֲכַ֥נִּי נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- ’ā·ḇîw ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ê·śāw bə·ḵō·re·ḵā ‘ā·śî·ṯî ka·’ă·šer dib·bar·tā ’ê·lāy qūm- nā šə·ḇāh wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh miṣ·ṣê·ḏî ba·‘ă·ḇūr tə·ḇā·ră·ḵan·nî nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: Jacob said to his father I am Esau your firstborn I have done as you told me . . . Please . . . sit up and eat some of my game so that you may bless me
verses.literalPt: Disse Jacó a seu pai: Eu sou Esaú, teu primogênito; fiz como me ordenaste; levanta-te, pois, senta-te e come da minha caça, para que a tua alma me abençõe.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִצְחָק֙ אֶל־ בְּנ֔וֹ מַה־ זֶּ֛ה מִהַ֥רְתָּ לִמְצֹ֖א בְּנִ֑י וַיֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֥י הִקְרָ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְפָנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yiṣ·ḥāq ’el- bə·nōw mah- zeh mi·har·tā lim·ṣō bə·nî way·yō·mer kî hiq·rāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lə·p̄ā·nāy
verses.literal: But Isaac asked . . . his son How did you ever find it so quickly my son Because the LORD your God brought it to me he replied
verses.literalPt: Perguntou Isaque a seu filho: Como é que achaste tão depressa, meu filho? Respondeu ele: Porque Jeová, teu Deus, a mandou ao meu encontro.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִצְחָק֙ אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֔ב גְּשָׁה־ נָּ֥א וַאֲמֻֽשְׁךָ֖ בְּנִ֑י הַֽאַתָּ֥ה זֶ֛ה בְּנִ֥י עֵשָׂ֖ו אִם־ לֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yiṣ·ḥāq ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ gə·šāh- nā wa·’ă·muš·ḵā bə·nî ha·’at·tāh zeh bə·nî ‘ê·śāw ’im- lō
verses.literal: Then Isaac said to Jacob Please come closer so I can touch you my son Are you really my son Esau or not
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Isaque a Jacó: Chega-te, pois, para que eu te apalpe, meu filho, e veja se tu és meu filho Esaú ou não.

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֧שׁ יַעֲקֹ֛ב אֶל־ יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִ֖יו וַיְמֻשֵּׁ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הַקֹּל֙ ק֣וֹל יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְהַיָּדַ֖יִם יְדֵ֥י עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gaš ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- yiṣ·ḥāq ’ā·ḇîw way·muš·šê·hū way·yō·mer haq·qōl qō·wl ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·hay·yā·ḏa·yim yə·ḏê ‘ê·śāw
verses.literal: So Jacob came close to his father Isaac who touched him and said The voice is the voice of Jacob but the hands are the hands of Esau
verses.literalPt: Chegou-se Jacó a seu pai Isaque, que o apalpou e disse: A voz é a voz de Jacó, porém as mãos são as mãos de Esaú.

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א הִכִּיר֔וֹ כִּֽי־ הָי֣וּ יָדָ֗יו כִּידֵ֛י עֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִ֖יו שְׂעִרֹ֑ת וַֽיְבָרְכֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō hik·kî·rōw kî- hā·yū yā·ḏāw kî·ḏê ‘ê·śāw ’ā·ḥîw śə·‘i·rōṯ way·ḇā·rə·ḵê·hū
verses.literal: Isaac did not recognize him because his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau so he blessed him
verses.literalPt: Não o reconheceu, porque as suas mãos estavam pelosas como as mãos de seu irmão Esaú; assim, o abençoou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אַתָּ֥ה זֶ֖ה בְּנִ֣י עֵשָׂ֑ו וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’at·tāh zeh bə·nî ‘ê·śāw way·yō·mer ’ā·nî
verses.literal: Again he asked Are you really my son Esau And he replied I am
verses.literalPt: Mas perguntou: És tu meu filho Esaú? Respondeu ele: Eu o sou.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הַגִּ֤שָׁה לִּי֙ וְאֹֽכְלָה֙ מִצֵּ֣יד בְּנִ֔י לְמַ֥עַן תְּבָֽרֶכְךָ֖ נַפְשִׁ֑י וַיַּגֶּשׁ־ לוֹ֙ וַיֹּאכַ֔ל וַיָּ֧בֵא ל֦וֹ יַ֖יִן וַיֵּֽשְׁתְּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hag·gi·šāh lî wə·’ō·ḵə·lāh miṣ·ṣêḏ bə·nî lə·ma·‘an tə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā nap̄·šî way·yag·geš- lōw way·yō·ḵal way·yā·ḇê lōw ya·yin way·yê·šət
verses.literal: Serve me said Isaac and let me eat some of my son’s game so that I may bless you Jacob brought it to him and he ate then he brought him wine and he drank
verses.literalPt: Disse, pois: Traze-mo, e comerei da caça de meu filho, para que a minha alma te abençoe. Trouxe-lho, e ele comeu; também trouxe vinho, e ele bebeu.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו יִצְחָ֣ק אָבִ֑יו גְּשָׁה־ נָּ֥א וּשְׁקָה־ לִּ֖י בְּנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw yiṣ·ḥāq ’ā·ḇîw gə·šāh- nā ū·šə·qāh- lî bə·nî
verses.literal: Then his father Isaac said to him Please come near and kiss me my son
verses.literalPt: Então, lhe disse Isaque, seu pai: Chega-te e dá-me um beijo, meu filho.

verses.original: וַיִּגַּשׁ֙ וַיִּשַּׁק־ ל֔וֹ וַיָּ֛רַח אֶת־ רֵ֥יחַ בְּגָדָ֖יו וַֽיְבָרֲכֵ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר רְאֵה֙ רֵ֣יחַ בְּנִ֔י כְּרֵ֣יחַ שָׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּרֲכ֖וֹ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gaš way·yiš·šaq- lōw way·yā·raḥ ’eṯ- rê·aḥ bə·ḡā·ḏāw way·ḇā·ră·ḵê·hū way·yō·mer rə·’êh rê·aḥ bə·nî kə·rê·aḥ śā·ḏeh ’ă·šer bê·ră·ḵōw Yah·weh
verses.literal: So he came near and kissed him When Isaac smelled his clothing he blessed him and said Ah the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the LORD has blessed
verses.literalPt: Chegou-se e deu-lhe um beijo. Sentindo seu pai o cheiro dos vestidos dele, o abençoou e disse: Eis que o cheiro de meu filho é como o cheiro de um campo que Jeová abençoou;

verses.original: וְיִֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֙ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מִטַּל֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּמִשְׁמַנֵּ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְרֹ֥ב דָּגָ֖ן וְתִירֹֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yit·ten- lə·ḵā hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm miṭ·ṭal haš·šā·ma·yim ū·miš·man·nê hā·’ā·reṣ wə·rōḇ dā·ḡān wə·ṯî·rōš
verses.literal: May God give to you the dew of heaven and the richness of the earth an abundance of grain and new wine
verses.literalPt: que Deus te dê do orvalho do céu, e dos lugares férteis da terra, e abundância de trigo e de mosto.

verses.original: יַֽעַבְד֣וּךָ עַמִּ֗ים וְיִשְׁתַּחוּ לְךָ֙ לְאֻמִּ֔ים הֱוֵ֤ה גְבִיר֙ לְאַחֶ֔יךָ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲוּ֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּנֵ֣י אִמֶּ֑ךָ אֹרְרֶ֣יךָ אָר֔וּר וּֽמְבָרֲכֶ֖יךָ בָּרֽוּךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘aḇ·ḏū·ḵā ‘am·mîm wə·yiš·ta·ḥū lə·ḵā lə·’um·mîm hĕ·wêh ḡə·ḇîr lə·’a·ḥe·ḵā wə·yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū lə·ḵā bə·nê ’im·me·ḵā ’ō·rə·re·ḵā ’ā·rūr ū·mə·ḇā·ră·ḵe·ḵā bā·rūḵ
verses.literal: May peoples serve you and nations bow down to you May you be the master of your brothers and may the sons of your mother bow down to you May those who curse you be cursed and those who bless you be blessed
verses.literalPt: Sirvam-te povos, e nações te reverenciem: Sê senhor de teus irmãos, e te reverenciem os filhos de tua mãe. Malditos sejam aqueles que te maldisserem, e benditos sejam aqueles que te bendisserem.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר כִּלָּ֣ה יִצְחָק֮ לְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹב֒ וַיְהִ֗י אַ֣ךְ יָצֹ֤א יָצָא֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב מֵאֵ֥ת פְּנֵ֖י יִצְחָ֣ק אָבִ֑יו וְעֵשָׂ֣ו אָחִ֔יו בָּ֖א מִצֵּידֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer kil·lāh yiṣ·ḥāq lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·hî ’aḵ yā·ṣō yā·ṣā ya·‘ă·qōḇ mê·’êṯ pə·nê yiṣ·ḥāq ’ā·ḇîw wə·‘ê·śāw ’ā·ḥîw bā miṣ·ṣê·ḏōw
verses.literal: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing him . . . . . . and Jacob . . . had left . . . his father’s presence . . . his brother Esau returned from the hunt
verses.literalPt: Logo que Isaque acabou de abençoar a Jacó, apenas havia este saído da presença de Isaque, seu pai, chegou da sua caçada Esaú, seu irmão.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ גַּם־ הוּא֙ מַטְעַמִּ֔ים וַיָּבֵ֖א לְאָבִ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְאָבִ֗יו יָקֻ֤ם אָבִי֙ וְיֹאכַל֙ מִצֵּ֣יד בְּנ֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר תְּבָרֲכַ֥נִּי נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś gam- hū maṭ·‘am·mîm way·yā·ḇê lə·’ā·ḇîw way·yō·mer lə·’ā·ḇîw yā·qum ’ā·ḇî wə·yō·ḵal miṣ·ṣêḏ bə·nōw ba·‘ă·ḇūr tə·ḇā·ră·ḵan·nî nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: He too made some tasty food brought it to his father and said to him My father sit up and eat of your son’s game so that you may bless me
verses.literalPt: Ele também preparou um manjar saboroso e, trazendo-o a seu pai, disse-lhe: Levanta-te, meu pai, e come da caça de teu filho, para que a tua alma me abençoe.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֛וֹ יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִ֖יו מִי־ אָ֑תָּה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֲנִ֛י בִּנְךָ֥ בְכֹֽרְךָ֖ עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw yiṣ·ḥāq ’ā·ḇîw mî- ’āt·tāh way·yō·mer ’ă·nî bin·ḵā ḇə·ḵō·rə·ḵā ‘ê·śāw
verses.literal: But his father Isaac replied Who are you I am Esau your firstborn son he answered
verses.literalPt: Perguntou-lhe Isaque, seu pai: Quem és tu? Respondeu ele: Eu sou teu filho, teu primogênito, Esaú.

verses.original: וַיֶּחֱרַ֨ד יִצְחָ֣ק חֲרָדָה֮ גְּדֹלָ֣ה עַד־ מְאֹד֒ וַיֹּ֡אמֶר מִֽי־ אֵפ֡וֹא ה֣וּא הַצָּֽד־ צַיִד֩ וַיָּ֨בֵא לִ֜י וָאֹכַ֥ל מִכֹּ֛ל בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא וָאֲבָרֲכֵ֑הוּ גַּם־ בָּר֖וּךְ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·ḥĕ·raḏ yiṣ·ḥāq ḥă·rā·ḏāh gə·ḏō·lāh ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ way·yō·mer mî- ’ê·p̄ō·w hū haṣ·ṣāḏ- ṣa·yiḏ way·yā·ḇê lî wā·’ō·ḵal mik·kōl bə·ṭe·rem tā·ḇō·w wā·’ă·ḇā·ră·ḵê·hū gam- bā·rūḵ yih·yeh
verses.literal: Isaac began to tremble violently . . . . . . . . . . . . and said Who was it then who hunted the game and brought it to me Before you came in I ate it all and blessed him and indeed he will be blessed
verses.literalPt: Então, estremeceu Isaque de um estremecimento muito grande e perguntou: Quem, pois, é aquele que apanhou caça e ma trouxe? Eu comi de tudo antes que viesses, abençoei-o, e ele será bendito.

verses.original: כִּשְׁמֹ֤עַ עֵשָׂו֙ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֣י אָבִ֔יו וַיִּצְעַ֣ק צְעָקָ֔ה גְּדֹלָ֥ה וּמָרָ֖ה עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְאָבִ֔יו בָּרֲכֵ֥נִי גַם־ אָ֖נִי אָבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kiš·mō·a‘ ‘ê·śāw ’eṯ- diḇ·rê ’ā·ḇîw way·yiṣ·‘aq ṣə·‘ā·qāh gə·ḏō·lāh ū·mā·rāh ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ way·yō·mer lə·’ā·ḇîw bā·ră·ḵê·nî ḡam- ’ā·nî ’ā·ḇî
verses.literal: When Esau heard his father’s words he let out a loud and bitter . . . . . . cry and said to his father Bless me too . . . O my father
verses.literalPt: Ao ouvir Esaú as palavras de seu pai, bradou com grande e mui amargo brado, dizendo a seu pai: Abençoa-me também a mim, meu pai!

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בָּ֥א אָחִ֖יךָ בְּמִרְמָ֑ה וַיִּקַּ֖ח בִּרְכָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bā ’ā·ḥî·ḵā bə·mir·māh way·yiq·qaḥ bir·ḵā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: But Isaac replied Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing
verses.literalPt: Respondeu seu pai: Veio teu irmão e tirou a tua bênção.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר הֲכִי֩ קָרָ֨א שְׁמ֜וֹ יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַֽיַּעְקְבֵ֙נִי֙ זֶ֣ה פַעֲמַ֔יִם אֶת־ בְּכֹרָתִ֣י לָקָ֔ח וְהִנֵּ֥ה עַתָּ֖ה לָקַ֣ח בִּרְכָתִ֑י וַיֹּאמַ֕ר הֲלֹא־ אָצַ֥לְתָּ לִּ֖י בְּרָכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hă·ḵî qā·rā šə·mōw ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·ya‘·qə·ḇê·nî zeh p̄a·‘ă·ma·yim ’eṯ- bə·ḵō·rā·ṯî lā·qāḥ wə·hin·nêh ‘at·tāh lā·qaḥ bir·ḵā·ṯî way·yō·mar hă·lō- ’ā·ṣal·tā lî bə·rā·ḵāh
verses.literal: So Esau declared Is he not rightly named . . . Jacob For he has cheated me . . . twice He took my birthright and now he has taken my blessing Then he asked Haven’t you saved a blessing for me
verses.literalPt: Disse Esaú: Não se chama ele com razão Jacó? Pois já duas vezes me enganou: tirou-me o direito da primogenitura, e eis que agora me tirou a bênção. E perguntou: Não tens reservado uma bênção para mim?

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן יִצְחָ֜ק וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְעֵשָׂ֗ו הֵ֣ן גְּבִ֞יר שַׂמְתִּ֥יו לָךְ֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֶחָ֗יו נָתַ֤תִּי לוֹ֙ לַעֲבָדִ֔ים וְדָגָ֥ן וְתִירֹ֖שׁ סְמַכְתִּ֑יו וּלְכָ֣ה אֵפ֔וֹא מָ֥ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה בְּנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an yiṣ·ḥāq way·yō·mer lə·‘ê·śāw hên gə·ḇîr śam·tîw lāḵ wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’e·ḥāw nā·ṯat·tî lōw la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wə·ḏā·ḡān wə·ṯî·rōš sə·maḵ·tîw ū·lə·ḵāh ’ê·p̄ō·w māh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh bə·nî
verses.literal: But Isaac . . . answered Esau Look I have made him your master and given him all his relatives as servants I have sustained him with grain and new wine What is left that I can do for you my son
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Isaque a Esaú: Eis que o tenho posto por senhor sobre ti e lhe tenho dado todos os seus irmãos por servos; de trigo e de mosto o tenho fortalecido; que, pois, farei por ti, meu filho?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו אֶל־ אָבִ֗יו הַֽבְרָכָ֨ה אַחַ֤ת הִֽוא־ לְךָ֙ אָבִ֔י בָּרֲכֵ֥נִי גַם־ אָ֖נִי אָבִ֑י וַיִּשָּׂ֥א עֵשָׂ֛ו קֹל֖וֹ וַיֵּֽבְךְּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ‘ê·śāw ’el- ’ā·ḇîw haḇ·rā·ḵāh ’a·ḥaṯ hî lə·ḵā ’ā·ḇî bā·ră·ḵê·nî ḡam- ’ā·nî ’ā·ḇî way·yiś·śā ‘ê·śāw qō·lōw way·yê·ḇək
verses.literal: Esau said to his father Do you have only one . . . blessing my father Bless me too . . . O my father Then Esau wept aloud . . .
verses.literalPt: Replicou Esaú a seu pai: Porventura, tens uma única bênção, meu pai? Abençoa-me, meu pai, também a mim. Levantou Esaú a voz e chorou.

verses.original: וַיַּ֛עַן יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִ֖יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֑יו הִנֵּ֞ה מִשְׁמַנֵּ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה מֽוֹשָׁבֶ֔ךָ וּמִטַּ֥ל הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם מֵעָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an yiṣ·ḥāq ’ā·ḇîw way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw hin·nêh miš·man·nê hā·’ā·reṣ yih·yeh mō·wō·šā·ḇe·ḵā ū·miṭ·ṭal haš·šā·ma·yim mê·‘āl
verses.literal: His father . . . . . . Isaac answered him Behold your dwelling place shall be away from the richness of the land away from the dew of heaven above
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe seu pai Isaque: Longe dos lugares férteis da terra será a tua habitação e sem o orvalho que cai do alto;

verses.original: וְעַל־ חַרְבְּךָ֣ תִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְאֶת־ אָחִ֖יךָ תַּעֲבֹ֑ד וְהָיָה֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּרִ֔יד וּפָרַקְתָּ֥ עֻלּ֖וֹ מֵעַ֥ל צַוָּארֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- ḥar·bə·ḵā ṯiḥ·yeh wə·’eṯ- ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ta·‘ă·ḇōḏ wə·hā·yāh ka·’ă·šer tā·rîḏ ū·p̄ā·raq·tā ‘ul·lōw mê·‘al ṣaw·wā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: You shall live by the sword and serve . . . your brother But when you rebel you will tear his yoke from your neck
verses.literalPt: pela tua espada viverás e a teu irmão servirás; quando te tornares impaciente, sacudirás o seu jugo de sobre a tua cerviz.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂטֹ֤ם עֵשָׂו֙ אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֔ב עַל־ הַ֨בְּרָכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּרֲכ֖וֹ אָבִ֑יו וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו בְּלִבּ֗וֹ יִקְרְבוּ֙ יְמֵי֙ אֵ֣בֶל אָבִ֔י וְאַֽהַרְגָ֖ה אֶת־ יַעֲקֹ֥ב אָחִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·ṭōm ‘ê·śāw ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ ‘al- hab·bə·rā·ḵāh ’ă·šer bê·ră·ḵōw ’ā·ḇîw way·yō·mer ‘ê·śāw bə·lib·bōw yiq·rə·ḇū yə·mê ’ê·ḇel ’ā·ḇî wə·’a·har·ḡāh ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ā·ḥî
verses.literal: Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing his father had given him And Esau said in his heart The days of mourning for my father are at hand then I will kill my brother Jacob
verses.literalPt: Esaú aborrecia a Jacó por causa da bênção com que seu pai o abençoou; e disse consigo: Vêm chegando os dias de luto por meu pai; então, matarei a Jacó, meu irmão.

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֣ד לְרִבְקָ֔ה אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י עֵשָׂ֖ו בְּנָ֣הּ הַגָּדֹ֑ל וַתִּשְׁלַ֞ח וַתִּקְרָ֤א לְיַעֲקֹב֙ בְּנָ֣הּ הַקָּטָ֔ן וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו הִנֵּה֙ עֵשָׂ֣ו אָחִ֔יךָ מִתְנַחֵ֥ם לְךָ֖ לְהָרְגֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yug·gaḏ lə·riḇ·qāh ’eṯ- diḇ·rê ‘ê·śāw bə·nāh hag·gā·ḏōl wat·tiš·laḥ wat·tiq·rā lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·nāh haq·qā·ṭān wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw hin·nêh ‘ê·śāw ’ā·ḥî·ḵā miṯ·na·ḥêm lə·ḵā lə·hā·rə·ḡe·ḵā
verses.literal: When the words of her older son Esau were relayed to Rebekah she sent for . . . her younger son Jacob and told him Look your brother Esau is consoling himself by plotting to kill you
verses.literalPt: As palavras de Esaú, seu filho mais velho, foram denunciadas a Rebeca, que mandou chamar a Jacó, seu filho mais moço, e lhe disse: Eis que Esaú, teu irmão, se consola a teu respeito, propondo matar-te.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֥ה בְנִ֖י שְׁמַ֣ע בְּקֹלִ֑י וְק֧וּם בְּרַח־ לְךָ֛ אֶל־ לָבָ֥ן אָחִ֖י חָרָֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ḇə·nî šə·ma‘ bə·qō·lî wə·qūm bə·raḥ- lə·ḵā ’el- lā·ḇān ’ā·ḥî ḥā·rā·nāh
verses.literal: So now my son obey my voice and flee at once to my brother Laban in Haran
verses.literalPt: Agora, meu filho, escuta a minha voz. Retira-te para a casa de Labão, meu irmão, em Harã,

verses.original: וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֥ עִמּ֖וֹ יָמִ֣ים אֲחָדִ֑ים עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־ תָּשׁ֖וּב חֲמַ֥ת אָחִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šaḇ·tā ‘im·mōw yā·mîm ’ă·ḥā·ḏîm ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- tā·šūḇ ḥă·maṯ ’ā·ḥî·ḵā
verses.literal: Stay with him for a while . . . until your brother’s fury subsides
verses.literalPt: e demora-te com ele alguns dias, até que passe o furor de teu irmão,

verses.original: עַד־ שׁ֨וּב אַף־ אָחִ֜יךָ מִמְּךָ֗ וְשָׁכַח֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֖י וּלְקַחְתִּ֣יךָ מִשָּׁ֑ם לָמָ֥ה אֶשְׁכַּ֛ל גַּם־ שְׁנֵיכֶ֖ם י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- šūḇ ’ap̄- ’ā·ḥî·ḵā mim·mə·ḵā wə·šā·ḵaḥ ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯā lōw wə·šā·laḥ·tî ū·lə·qaḥ·tî·ḵā miš·šām lā·māh ’eš·kal gam- šə·nê·ḵem yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: until your brother’s rage against you wanes and he forgets what you have done to him Then I will send for you and bring you back from there Why should I lose both of you in one day
verses.literalPt: até que passe de ti a ira de teu irmão, e ele se esqueça do que lhe fizeste. Então, enviarei e te trarei de lá; por que seria eu desfilhada de ambos vós num só dia?

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר רִבְקָה֙ אֶל־ יִצְחָ֔ק קַ֣צְתִּי בְחַיַּ֔י מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנ֣וֹת חֵ֑ת אִם־ לֹקֵ֣חַ יַ֠עֲקֹב אִשָּׁ֨ה מִבְּנֽוֹת־ חֵ֤ת כָּאֵ֙לֶּה֙ מִבְּנ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ לָ֥מָּה לִּ֖י חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer riḇ·qāh ’el- yiṣ·ḥāq qaṣ·tî ḇə·ḥay·yay mip·pə·nê bə·nō·wṯ ḥêṯ ’im- lō·qê·aḥ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’iš·šāh mib·bə·nō·wṯ- ḥêṯ kā·’êl·leh mib·bə·nō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ lām·māh lî ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: Then Rebekah said to Isaac I am weary of my life because of these Hittite women If Jacob takes a Hittite wife from among them . . . . . . what good is my life
verses.literalPt: Disse Rebeca a Isaque: Enfadada estou da minha vida por causa das filhas de Hete; se Jacó tomar mulher dentre as filhas de Hete, tais como estas, dentre as filhas da terra, de que me servirá a vida?
